capture_method: Direct HTTP fetches of the resolved upstream media URLs (a.fsdn.com Allura icons/screenshots, a.fsdn.com/con sandiego chrome assets) as referenced by the captured sourceforge.net pages; screenshots resized to <=800px JPEG; mislabeled icon formats re-encoded to PNG.
notes: Covers every managed media file under static/images/ and static/external_cache/; the seed database is deterministically generated at build time from the tracked source_data/ snapshots (see .build-generated-seed).
Every entry is byte- and hash-verified by scripts/check_asset_inventory.py during the Docker build.
All source URLs are real upstream media URLs served by sourceforge.net / a.fsdn.com as rendered on the snapshot date.
Project icons and screenshots are the real Allura media for each project; UI chrome assets are the real SourceForge sandiego-theme assets.
